steps.placement_decision: cited step (proposition_20 a b e AB BD AC — I.20, two sides exceed the third, in triangle a-b-e): |b-a| + |a-e| > |b-e|
cited step (proposition_20 e d c BD DC AC — I.20 in triangle e-d-c): |d-e| + |e-c| > |d-c|
cited step (proposition_16 c e d b AC BD DC — the exterior-angle theorem in triangle c-d-e, with b on the extension of e-d past d): the exterior angle c:d:b (= b:d:c) exceeds the interior angle d:e:c

cited step (proposition_16 b a e c AB AC BD — the exterior-angle theorem in triangle a-b-e, with c on the extension of a-e past e): the exterior angle b:e:c exceeds the interior angle e:a:b (= b:a:c, e on a-c). The conclusion's why: for the lengths, |b-d| + |d-c| < |b-d| + |d-e| + |e-c| (the second I.20 step) = |b-e| + |e-c| (between b d e) < |b-a| + |a-e| + |e-c| (the first I.20 step) = |b-a| + |a-c| (between a e c); for the angles, angle b:d:c > angle d:e:c (the first I.16 step) = angle b:e:c (d on the ray e->b, between b d e) > angle e:a:b = angle b:a:c (e between a and c)

lean_text: theorem proposition_21 : ∀ (a b c d : Point) (AB BC AC BD DC : Line),
formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ (a.sameSide d BC) ∧ (c.sameSide d AB) ∧ (b.sameSide d AC) ∧
distinctPointsOnLine b d BD ∧ distinctPointsOnLine d c DC →
euclid_apply (proposition_20 a b e AB BD AC)
euclid_apply (proposition_20 e d c BD DC AC)
. euclid_apply (proposition_16 c e d b AC BD DC)
euclid_apply (proposition_16 b a e c AB AC BD)
